title: Learning Marginal Viewpoint Utility for Budgeted Evidence Selection in RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.29234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over multi-viewpoint queries must preserve distinct answers and positions from the retrieved evidence while operating under a fixed context budget. We introduce LMVU, a lightweight ranker that learns to prioritize candidates by the marginal viewpoint coverage they add to the current selection. Training uses viewpoint annotations from each benchmark's development split to compare candidates within the same selection state. At inference, LMVU repeatedly scores budget-feasible candidates as the context grows, without accessing these annotations. We evaluate two forms of recovered viewpoint coverage: RVC$_1$ assigns each viewpoint full credit for at least one supporting source unit, while RVC$_2$ assigns half credit for one and full credit for two or more distinct source units. Exact oracles measure achievable coverage under the same evidence pool and budget. Across four viewpoint-annotated benchmarks at a 1,02

translated_title: 面向RAG预算约束证据选择的边际视角效用学习
translated_abstract: 在多视角查询上的检索增强生成（RAG）必须在固定的上下文预算下，从检索到的证据中保留不同的答案和立场。我们提出了LMVU，一个轻量级的排序器，它学习根据候选证据为当前选择所增加的边际视角覆盖来对其进行优先级排序。训练时使用每个基准测试开发集中的视角标注，在同一选择状态下对候选进行比较。在推理阶段，随着上下文的增长，LMVU反复对符合预算的候选进行评分，而无需访问这些标注。我们评估了两种恢复视角覆盖的形式：RVC₁在某个视角至少有一个支持来源单元时给予满分，而RVC₂在仅有一个支持来源单元时给予一半分数，在有两个或更多不同来源单元时给予满分。精确的oracle（理论最优解）用于在相同的证据池和预算下测量可实现的覆盖。在四个带视角标注的基准测试上，在1,02（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出轻量级排序器LMVU，通过学习候选证据为当前选择新增的边际视角覆盖来动态优先排序证据，从而在固定上下文预算下最大化多视角查询RAG的视角覆盖效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes LMVU, a lightweight ranker that learns to prioritize candidates by the marginal viewpoint coverage they add to the current selection, maximizing viewpoint coverage for multi-viewpoint RAG queries under a fixed context budget.
